'''Corpbane{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1696803121450663990|date=30 August 2023|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/105060|archivedate=30 August 2023|quote=They're both classified as spears internally. The Corp actually uses a separate parameter called "corpbane" that's applied to individual spears/halberds that have been enabled against it.}} weapons''' are [[melee]] [[weapons]] that deal full damage against the [[Corporeal Beast]] when using the [[stab]] attack style. This page contains a complete list of Corpbane weapons distinguished by their [[Weapons/Categories|weapon category]].

Note: The [[Weapon_poison_(disambiguation)|poisoned]] variants of these weapons are also Corpbane, though the Corporeal Beast is immune to both [[poison]] and [[venom]].
